CustomObject.description: Defines donor giving groupings for the Fundraising Quick Start. Each record represents one grouping with a minimum gift amount threshold, an internal key, and a branded display name. The DonorGiftSummary formula fields FQS_Donor_Level__c and FQS_Donor_Level_Name__c reference these records. Admins can adjust thresholds and names in Setup without redeployment.
CustomObject.label: FQS Donor Grouping
